    - Dunmor. Lamplighter. My father Tormod lit them before me, and I walked behind him with the tinder box till I could carry the pole.
    - When he died I picked the pole up the next evening and went on. Nobody appointed me. Nobody needed to.
    - How I met Iska? She came in late off a night pilotage, soaked and furious at some captain, and I held a lantern up for her on the bottom step.
    - I held it up most nights after that, for a year, before she noticed I was waiting for her and not the ships. She says I took my time. I say I was being thorough.
    - Gunna makes them, the old way, from the first camp. I don't know how, and I've never asked. Some things are better kept by the people who keep them. I just know what each one needs, and when.
    - Iska, on a bad tide. I light the end of the quay first and stand by it till she's in. She doesn't know I wait. She knows.
